skill.name: manifest
skill.description: Install and configure the Manifest observability plugin for Claude-compatible agents, including API key setup, endpoint selection, gateway control, and log verification.
skill.summary: Set up Manifest observability for agents with guided plugin installation, telemetry configuration, and connection checks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Manifest setup guide with several legitimate command examples, and many static backtick findings are Markdown false positives. Confirmed risks remain because it installs or changes local Claude plugin state, handles and persists an API key, reads a hidden gateway log file, and can route telemetry to an external or custom endpoint.

remediation.issue: API key is provided through chat and written directly into local configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Use a secure secret input flow where available, avoid echoing the key, and document where the key is stored and how to rotate or remove it.

remediation.issue: Gateway log inspection reads a hidden file in the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit permission before reading logs, limit output to Manifest-related lines, and redact tokens, paths, or user data before displaying results.

remediation.issue: Custom endpoints can redirect agent telemetry.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of the endpoint, prefer HTTPS, and warn users that telemetry will be sent to the configured destination.

remediation.issue: The skill runs commands that change local gateway and plugin state.
remediation.suggestion: Show each command before execution and confirm before installing plugins, restarting gateways, or disabling diagnostics plugins.

content.value_statement: Agent teams need reliable telemetry before they can diagnose runtime problems. This skill guides Manifest plugin installation, API key setup, endpoint configuration, gateway restart, and log checks.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through stopping and restarting the Claude gateway for configuration changes.
Installs the Manifest plugin using the Claude plugin command shown in the skill.
Requests a Manifest API key and checks that it starts with the expected prefix.
Configures the Manifest API key and optional custom telemetry endpoint.
Checks recent gateway logs for a Manifest pipeline status message.
Provides troubleshooting steps for missing keys, invalid key format, unreachable endpoints, and duplicate telemetry registration.
limitations: Requires the Claude CLI and gateway commands to be available in the local environment.
Requires a valid Manifest account and API key supplied by the user.
Does not design custom dashboards, alerts, or broader observability architecture.
Reads local gateway logs during verification, which may expose operational details.

use_cases.title: Install Agent Telemetry
use_cases.description: Set up Manifest monitoring for an agent that already uses the Claude gateway.

use_cases.title: Connect a Self-Hosted Endpoint
use_cases.description: Configure a custom Manifest-compatible endpoint for teams that run their own telemetry service.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Plugin Startup
use_cases.description: Check gateway logs and common configuration errors when the Manifest plugin does not report as active.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants the standard hosted Manifest configuration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Manifest skill to set up observability for my agent with the default hosted endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Add API Key
prompt_templates.scenario: A user already has a Manifest API key and wants help configuring it safely.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Manifest skill to configure my Manifest API key, verify the key format, and avoid printing the key after setup.

prompt_templates.title: Use Custom Endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: A platform team uses a private or self-hosted telemetry endpoint.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Manifest skill to connect my agent to a custom Manifest endpoint and verify the gateway after configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Failed Connection
prompt_templates.scenario: The plugin was installed but telemetry is not visible.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Manifest skill to troubleshoot why the Manifest plugin is not active, check recent gateway logs, and suggest the next fix.

output_examples.input: Set up Manifest observability for my agent.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops the gateway, installs the Manifest plugin, asks for the API key, configures the plugin, restarts the gateway, and checks recent logs for the active pipeline message.
The assistant asks for the endpoint, configures it after the API key, restarts the gateway, and verifies that the Manifest pipeline reports as active.
The assistant reviews the expected key format, checks whether the endpoint is reachable, inspects recent gateway log lines, and recommends a targeted configuration fix.

best_practices: Confirm the user wants Manifest telemetry before installing or changing plugin settings.
Avoid repeating or logging the API key after it has been provided.
Use the default hosted endpoint unless the user explicitly needs a self-hosted endpoint.
anti_patterns: Do not configure an API key that does not match the expected Manifest prefix.
Do not change the telemetry endpoint without explicit user confirmation.
Do not paste broad gateway logs into chat when only Manifest-related lines are needed.

faq.question: What does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It configures the Manifest observability plugin for Claude-compatible agents and verifies that the gateway reports the plugin as active.

faq.question: Does it require a Manifest account?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup requires a Manifest API key from a hosted or self-hosted Manifest deployment.

faq.question: Can it use a self-hosted endpoint?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a custom endpoint path for users who explicitly provide their own Manifest endpoint.

faq.question: Will it expose my API key?
faq.answer: The skill tells the assistant not to log or echo the key after configuration, but the key is still provided in chat during setup.

faq.question: What local files does it read?
faq.answer: For verification, it reads recent Claude gateway log lines that mention Manifest.

faq.question: Is it a general observability design tool?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on installing and troubleshooting the Manifest plugin, not designing dashboards or alert policies.
